item.title: J&J IBD Combo Failure
item.description:
• Summary: Johnson & Johnson announced that its experimental combination therapy for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) failed to show meaningful improvement over placebo in two Phase 2 studies. Despite the miss, the company plans to advance the regimen into pivotal trials. The combination involved J&J's anti‑IL‑23 antibody guselkumab and an investigational agent, underscoring the challenges of achieving synergy in autoimmune disease.
  • MoAs: Anti‑IL‑23 monoclonal antibody combined with an additional targeted mechanism
  • Sources: Endpoints News, STAT News
